$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The URL of the JSON schema describing this document's structure.

FormatVersion.title: Format Version
FormatVersion.description: The version of this JSON document's structure. Readers should reject documents with an unrecognized version rather than guessing at compatibility.

AppName.title: Application Name
AppName.description: The name of the application that produced this document.

AppVersion.title: Application Version
AppVersion.description: The version of the application that produced this document.

CreatedAt.title: Created At
CreatedAt.description: The timestamp at which this document was generated, formatted per RFC 1123 with numeric time zone (e.g. "Mon, 02 Jan 2006 15:04:05 -0700").

TraceID.title: Trace ID
TraceID.description: A globally unique identifier for this specific task result, used for tracing and correlation.

Kind.title: Result Kind
Kind.description: The result status: Passed (answer accepted), Failed (answer rejected), Error (task execution failed), or Skipped (task not supported/attempted). An "Unknown (n)" fallback is possible but not expected in practice.

Task.title: Task Name
Task.description: The name of the executed task.

Provider.title: Provider Name
Provider.description: The name of the AI provider that executed the task.

Run.title: Run Name
Run.description: The name of the provider's run configuration used.

MaxRequestsPerMinute.title: Max Requests Per Minute
MaxRequestsPerMinute.description: The maximum number of API requests per minute that was permitted for this configuration. A value of 0 (or absent) means no rate limiting was applied.

TextOnly.title: Text Only
TextOnly.description: Whether this configuration was restricted to text-only tasks (i.e. tasks without file attachments).

DisableStructuredOutput.title: Disable Structured Output
DisableStructuredOutput.description: Whether this configuration used plain text responses instead of the structured title/explanation/final-answer format, skipping tasks that require schema-based output.

ModelParameters.title: Model Parameters
ModelParameters.description: The public subset of model parameters used by this configuration, with secrets omitted.

MaxRetryAttempts.title: Max Retry Attempts
MaxRetryAttempts.description: The maximum number of retry attempts for a transient failure.

InitialDelaySeconds.title: Initial Delay Seconds
InitialDelaySeconds.description: The initial backoff delay before the first retry attempt.

RetryPolicy.title: Retry Policy
RetryPolicy.description: The effective retry policy for this configuration, if configured.

Currency.title: Currency
Currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code the rates are expressed in.

InputPerMillion.title: Input Price Per Million
InputPerMillion.description: The price per million uncached input tokens.

OutputPerMillion.title: Output Price Per Million
OutputPerMillion.description: The price per million generated output tokens.

CacheReadPerMillion.title: Cache Read Price Per Million
CacheReadPerMillion.description: The price per million input tokens read from a prompt cache. Falls back to the input price when absent.

CacheWritePerMillion.title: Cache Write Price Per Million
CacheWritePerMillion.description: The price per million input tokens written to a prompt cache. Falls back to the input price when absent.

ReasoningPerMillion.title: Reasoning Price Per Million
ReasoningPerMillion.description: The price per million reasoning tokens. Falls back to the output price when absent.

Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description: The effective token prices this configuration was estimated with, if configured. Preserved so historical cost estimates remain reproducible.

RunConfig.title: Run Configuration
RunConfig.description: The effective run configuration used to produce this result (e.g. model, rate limits, retry policy), with any API keys or other secrets omitted.

Got.title: Actual Answer
Got.description: The actual answer received from the AI model. For plain text response format, a string that follows the format instruction precisely. For structured schema-based response format, any object that conforms to the task's response schema.

Want.title: Expected Answer(s)
Want.description: The accepted valid answer(s) for the task, as a single value or an array of values. For plain text response format: string values that should follow the format instruction precisely. For structured schema-based response format: object values that conform to the task's response schema.

Suite.title: Suite
Suite.description: An optional grouping label for organizing related tasks (e.g. a benchmark suite name).

Category.title: Category
Category.description: An optional classification label for the task (e.g. "math", "coding").

Difficulty.title: Difficulty
Difficulty.description: An optional free-form difficulty label for the task (e.g. "easy", "hard").

Tags.title: Tags
Tags.description: An optional set of free-form labels for filtering and grouping tasks.

TaskMetadata.title: Task Metadata
TaskMetadata.description: Optional descriptive labels copied from the originating task.

Title.title: Title
Title.description: A descriptive header for the response produced by the target AI model.

Explanation.title: Explanation
Explanation.description: Explanation of the answer produced by the target AI model, split into lines.

ActualAnswer.title: Actual Answer Lines
ActualAnswer.description: The raw answer from the target AI model split into lines.

ExpectedAnswer.title: Expected Answer Lines
ExpectedAnswer.description: A set of all acceptable correct answers, each being an array of lines.

InputTokens.title: Input Tokens
InputTokens.description: The input token count reported by the provider. Interpret cache token counters according to InputTokenAccounting.

OutputTokens.title: Output Tokens
OutputTokens.description: The number of generated output tokens. Interpret the reasoning token counter according to OutputTokenAccounting.

ReasoningTokens.title: Reasoning Tokens
ReasoningTokens.description: The number of reasoning (thinking) tokens reported by the provider. Interpret this counter according to OutputTokenAccounting. Absent when the provider does not report it.

InputCacheWriteTokens.title: Input Cache Write Tokens
InputCacheWriteTokens.description: The number of input tokens written into a provider prompt cache.

InputCacheReadTokens.title: Input Cache Read Tokens
InputCacheReadTokens.description: The number of input tokens read from a provider prompt cache.

InputTokenAccounting.title: Input Token Accounting
InputTokenAccounting.description: Defines how cached input-token counters relate to InputTokens. For cache_tokens_separate, InputTokens excludes InputCacheReadTokens and InputCacheWriteTokens, so total input usage is their sum. For cache_tokens_included, cached token counters are subsets already included in InputTokens, so total input usage is InputTokens. When absent, consumers should use cache_tokens_separate for backward compatibility.

OutputTokenAccounting.title: Output Token Accounting
OutputTokenAccounting.description: Defines how ReasoningTokens relates to OutputTokens. For reasoning_tokens_included, reasoning is already represented by OutputTokens and ReasoningTokens is an informational subset. For reasoning_tokens_separate, reasoning is excluded from OutputTokens and must be added to obtain total generated usage. When absent, consumers should use reasoning_tokens_included for backward compatibility.

Usage.title: Token Usage
Usage.description: Token usage statistics for generating the answer.

CallCount.title: Call Count
CallCount.description: The number of times the tool's underlying process actually ran.

TotalDurationNS.title: Total Duration (ns)
TotalDurationNS.description: The cumulative execution time for the tool's underlying process, in nanoseconds.

ToolUsage.title: Tool Usage
ToolUsage.description: Aggregated execution statistics, keyed by tool name, for any tools invoked while producing the answer.

Tool.title: Tool Name
Tool.description: The name of the tool this call invoked.

CallID.title: Call ID
CallID.description: Identifies this call, letting a specific invocation be correlated between this summary, the corresponding tool-call log lines, and - when the calling provider's API assigns its own tool-call ID and that ID was reused here - the provider's own API error messages. Never empty, but its shape/format is not guaranteed to be consistent across providers.

ConversationTurn.title: Conversation Turn
ConversationTurn.description: The 1-based conversation turn this call was made during, or absent/0 if unknown.

StartedAt.title: Started At
StartedAt.description: When this call began (start of setup, before the underlying process runs).

CompletedAt.title: Completed At
CompletedAt.description: When this call finished, successfully or not.

DurationNS.title: Duration (ns)
DurationNS.description: The wall-clock duration of the underlying process's runtime, in nanoseconds, not including setup/teardown overhead. Absent when no process ever ran (e.g. an infrastructure_error).

WallTimeNS.title: Wall Time (ns)
WallTimeNS.description: The wall-clock duration of the entire call attempt, in nanoseconds, from setup through output retrieval - i.e. DurationNS plus setup/teardown overhead. Unlike DurationNS, this is always set, even for calls whose underlying process never ran.

ExitCode.title: Exit Code
ExitCode.description: The underlying process's exit code, or absent if no exit code is known.

TimedOut.title: Timed Out
TimedOut.description: Whether the call was aborted due to exceeding its configured timeout.

Bytes.title: Bytes
Bytes.description: The total size of the output stream, in bytes, regardless of Truncated.

Preview.title: Preview
Preview.description: A truncated prefix of the output stream, or absent if not captured or empty.

Truncated.title: Truncated
Truncated.description: Whether Preview was cut short of the full output.

Stdout.title: Standard Output
Stdout.description: A size-limited capture of the call's standard output, or absent if no output was ever captured.

ErrorMessage.title: Error Message
ErrorMessage.description: A short explanation of the failure when Status is not "success".

ToolCalls.title: Tool Calls
ToolCalls.description: A log of every individual invocation attempt made while producing the answer, including attempts that never actually ran. Tracked separately from ToolUsage, which only reflects invocations that actually ran.

Answer.title: Answer Details
Answer.description: Details about the AI model's response and reasoning process.

ResponseParsing.title: Response Parsing
ResponseParsing.description: True when the model response was received but failed to parse into the expected structure; absent otherwise. When Transient is also absent, this failure should generally be treated as non-transient (retrying with the same input is unlikely to help).

Transient.title: Transient
Transient.description: Whether the error appears temporary/external (true), appears permanent/hard (false), or is unknown (field absent). A best-effort classification, not a complete error taxonomy.

FromValidation.title: From Validation
FromValidation.description: True when Usage/ToolUsage/ToolCalls above belong to the judge's validation attempt rather than the candidate response, so aggregate consumers must not attribute them to the candidate.

Error.title: Error Details

Details.title: Details
Details.description: Comprehensive information about the generated response and validation assessment.

DurationNS.title: Duration (ns)
DurationNS.description: The cumulative time the AI model itself spent generating a response, in nanoseconds, summed across every conversation turn's model request (network + inference). Excludes local tool execution time (see ToolCalls/ToolUsage) and any subsequent validation time, so this is not the total wall-clock time spent processing the task.
